artworks.title: Mulier Matrisana
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing upright in full-length profile view. She is facing right with her hands folded in front of her torso. She has a distinct nose and closed lips. She wears a headscarf covering her hair, which is tied at the back and draped over her shoulders. Her outfit includes a patterned dress with horizontal stripes on the sleeves and a vertically striped apron-like garment with intricate geometric designs. She also wears long skirts and plain shoes. The background has a textured surface with faded writing at the top and bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Nobilis Mulier Aulica Anglicana
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman in a full-length portrait standing in profile, turned slightly to her left. She has tightly curled hair, a high forehead, and is wearing an elaborate gown with lace trim on the collar and cuffs. She is holding a folded fan at her waistline and wearing a pearl necklace. The background is plain with text inscriptions including "Lady of the Court of England" and "Nobilis Mulier Aulica Anglicana."

artworks.title: Nobilis Mulier Anglica
artworks.artist: Wenceslaus Hollar after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a woman in full-body profile facing right. She is holding a fan in her right hand at waist level. Her hair is styled elegantly with an elaborate bun, curls framing her face. She has delicate facial features with a serene expression. She wears an ornate gown with lace detail on the bodice and sleeves, and a flowing skirt. She also wears a choker or lace collar. The background is plain, with the inscription "Nobilis Mulier Anglica," the artist's details, and the year 1644 at the top.

artworks.title: Nobilis Mulier Anglica, in Vestitu Hiemali
artworks.description: The image shows a person facing to the right, wearing historical ornate attire, including a voluminous dress with a fur-trimmed cape and a head covering that conceals the lower part of the face. The clothing appears to be made of heavy and luxurious fabrics. The hand is not visible. The background is plain, and text below the figure reads "Nobilis Mulier Anglica."

artworks.title: Nobilis Mulier Anglicana
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body illustration of an English noblewoman. She is standing upright, slightly turned towards her left, with her left arm extended in front of her. The woman's facial features include a slightly rounded face, a small chin, and an expressionless gaze towards the viewer. Her hair is curly and shoulder-length, with ringlets framing her face. She wears an intricate gown with a high collar, puffed sleeves, and lace details. She holds a small purse in her left hand that hangs down at her side. The background is plain. The engraving features detailed lines capturing the texture of her clothing and hair. The text "Nobilis Mulier Anglicana" at the bottom of the image identifies her as an English noblewoman.

artworks.title: Mulier Nobilis aut Generosa Anglica
artworks.description: The image shows the full body of a woman standing in profile facing left. She has delicate facial features with a slightly pointed nose and her hair is styled in an updo with some curls falling down her neck. She wears a long, layered gown with puffed sleeves, wide cuffs, and a wide collar draping over her shoulders. The skirt is gathered at the back into a bustle. She is holding a decorative fan in her left hand. There are no visible jewelry or additional objects. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Mulier Generosa Anglica
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing upright with a solemn expression. She has narrow eyes, a pointed nose, and wears a bonnet covering her hair. She is dressed in period-specific attire including a long gown, a shawl, and gloves. She holds a small object in her left hand by her side. The background is plain, emphasizing the woman. The text above and below the figure identifies her as an "English Gentlewoman" with "Mulier Generosa Anglica" at the bottom.

artworks.title: Mulier Generosa Anglica
artworks.description: The image shows a woman in profile, facing right. She is wearing a long gown with a shawl, holding a fur muff in front of her. The background is plain with two handwritten captions - "English Gentle woman" at the top left and "Mulier Generosa Anglica" at the bottom.

artworks.title: Mulier Generosa Anglica
artworks.description: The image is an illustration of a woman standing. She has a composed expression, visible eyebrows and is looking ahead. Her hair is styled in an updo with curls falling around her face. She wears a long-sleeved dress with a fitted bodice, square neckline, full skirt, and sash at the waist. One hand holds part of the fabric. The background is plain. Writing in the top right corner reads "Ein Englische vom Adel 164" and "Mulier Generosa Anglica" is at the bottom of the illustration.

artworks.title: Mulier Anglica Habitans in Pago
artworks.description: The image depicts a full-body view of a standing woman in profile facing to the right. She has short, curly hair and is wearing a traditional 17th-century English outfit. The woman is holding a round basket with a goose inside at waist height.

artworks.title: Dni Maioris sive Praetoris Londinensis  Vxoris Hab:
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing upright. She is facing forward and wearing an elaborate outfit with a large-brimmed hat. The outfit includes a high-collared dress, a bodice with a striped pattern, and a long skirt. She is holding a pom-pom like object in her right hand and wearing earrings. The background is plain, and there is text in an older calligraphic style at the top right and bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Ciuis Londinensis Melioris Qualitatis Vxor
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing in a side profile. She is positioned with her body slightly turned to the left, and her face turned towards the viewer's left. Her facial features are detailed with a pointed nose, and she has short hair covered by a wide-brimmed hat. She wears a long dress with lace detailing on the sleeves and bodice, and the fabric drapes elegantly around her. She holds a fold of her dress in her hand. The background is plain, with handwritten text above indicating her as a "Marchants wife of London." There are no other objects or embellishments in the image.

artworks.title: Civis Londinensis Vxor
artworks.description: This image shows a woman standing in profile, facing to the right. Her facial features are obscured by her hat's shadow. She has short hair visible under a wide-brimmed hat. She wears a long coat with detailed patterns and a prominent collar, over a long dress with visible folds. The woman stands on a textured surface, with a plain or lightly speckled background. There is text above and below the image that reads "Citizen's wife" and "Civis Londinensis Uxor."

artworks.title: Civis Londinensis Filia
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman standing in profile, facing to her right. Her body is turned slightly, with her right arm bent and resting across her body. She wears a cap tied under her chin, framing her face. Her hair is visible peeking from under the cap in tight curls. She is dressed in a long gown with a light-colored apron over it, and a large, pointed collar covering her shoulders. Her sleeves are long and buttoned at the cuffs. The gown appears to be of a dark color with delicate detailing along the edges. There is no visible jewelry. The background is plain with a faint texture, and handwritten inscriptions at the top and bottom of the image read “Citizens daughter” and “Civis Londinensis Filia.”

artworks.title: Ciuis vel Artificis Londinensis Vxor
artworks.description: The image is of a woman standing sideways. She has her hands clasped at her waist and is looking forward. She is wearing a large brimmed hat, a long dark gown with a white shawl, a patterned apron, and shoes with buckles. The background is plain with text and minimal detailing.

artworks.title: Mercatoris Londinensis Filia
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body side profile of a woman with long curly hair standing upright. She is wearing a dark dress with long sleeves, a light-colored collar, and an apron draped over her attire. She has gloved hands held together in front of her, and a chain with a small spherical object hanging at her waist. The background is plain, with the words "Marchants: daughter" above her, and "Mercatoris Londinensis Filia" below her.

artworks.title: Mulier Scotica
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman standing in profile. She is facing to the right, with her head turned slightly towards the viewer. She has an elongated face, pronounced eyes, a straight nose, and a small mouth. Her hair is partially covered by an ornate hood that is part of her garment. She is wearing a traditional Scottish outfit, including a voluminous cloak with fur trim and a ruffled collar. The cloak is dark, contrasting with the lighter undergarment peeking through. The attire seems heavy, suitable for cold climates. In her hand, she holds a tasselled string. The background is plain with no additional elements. The words “a Scotch Woman” and “Mulier Scotica” are inscribed on the image.

artworks.title: Mulier Hibernica vel Irlandica
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing upright with her hands tucked under her large fur-lined cloak. Her face features delicate, finely drawn details with soft lines, and she has dark eyes and a small, slightly upturned mouth. Her hair is mostly covered by a cloth cap or headdress that extends backward. Her clothing is dominated by the voluminous cloak that drapes down to the ground, with a pronounced fur collar framing her neck and shoulders. The cloak opens at the chest to reveal a high-necked garment adorned with a cross pendant on a chain around her neck. There are no other visible articles of jewelry or objects she is holding. The background consists of a plain, lightly textured surface.

artworks.title: Mulier Aulica Turca
artworks.description: The image shows a full-length portrait of a person standing upright. The individual is positioned with one hand on their hip and the other resting over their stomach. They have a composed expression on their face, characterized by defined facial features and a slightly upward gaze. They are wearing a headpiece and a long, intricately patterned dress with long sleeves cinched at the waist with a belt, and a large piece of fabric drapes around their shoulders and down their back. They are wearing pointed shoes with a raised heel and a large, ornate piece of jewelry around their neck. The background is a plain, light-toned canvas with minimal texture.

artworks.title: Mulier Generosa Graeca in Civitate Pera
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing upright with her hands positioned over her abdomen. She has a calm expression, slightly downcast eyes, finely drawn facial features, long hair cascading over her shoulders, and is adorned with a decorated headpiece and intricate gown. She wears an elaborate necklace and the background is plain.

artworks.title: Mulier Hebrea in Tracia
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman standing facing slightly to the left. She is shown in a standing position with her right arm extended outward and the left arm bent and resting on her body. Her face is in a three-quarter view with distinct facial features and a calm expression, with her hair partially covered by a headscarf. She is wearing a long patterned dress with intricate designs and a cloak draped over her shoulders. The woman is adorned with a necklace, and there is a decorative element at her waist. The background of the image is plain, and the focus is on the woman. The art style suggests it is an etching, typical of historical portraiture.

artworks.title: Mulier Habitans Algieri
artworks.description: The image depicts a person standing upright wearing a hooded cloak that covers their head and falls down around their body. Their face, visible through the hood, features large eyes and a straight nose. The person's hair is not visible. They wear long, loose-fitting garments beneath the cloak that reach the ground, leaving their left foot exposed. The individual is holding the cloak closed at the neck with one hand. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Mulier Moresca
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing, facing slightly to the left. The person's face is partially obscured by a hood, but visible facial features include a prominent nose and eyes. The individual wears a long, flowing garment that appears to include a cloak or a cape draped over the shoulders and fastened at the front with a decorated belt. The garment underneath has a number of buttons visible at the chest, and the sleeves are long and fitted. One hand is positioned over the chest, while the other is lifted slightly, and the person is holding a patterned cloth. The feet are covered by fabric, visible beneath the hem of the clothing. The figure wears a head covering that is both a hat and a veil that frames the face. The background of the image is plain, with no distinct features or objects.

artworks.title: Mulier Persiana
artworks.description: The image features an illustration of a woman standing in profile. She has distinct facial features, styled hair, and is wearing a gown with a cloak draped over her. Her hands are together in front of her. The background is plain. Inscriptions in the top right and bottom corners indicate her as a Persian woman.
